* [[Master Luke (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata)|Errata]]: Holotable’s May 2010 card data reads “with Luke in owner’s Force Pile” and spells out the pilot icon.<ref name="master-luke-holotable-data">[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/5047de05901542129fe590e6f4c7d1c0c4036bbd/db/lightside.cdf Holotable Light Side card data], version 20100529, copied into the VKit repository in July 2010.</ref> The Players Committee’s card indexes captured in July 2012 and January 2013 give the same wording in the Rebel icon’s alternate text.<ref name="cl-1230_76-2012-07-21">Players Committee card index listing Master Luke (V), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142208/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* [[Master Luke (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata 2)|Errata 2]]: The Players Committee full card image<ref name="master-luke-restored-composite">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock3-Light/large/masterluke.gif full Virtual Block 3 card image].</ref> and the Master List slip, official text as of 27 April 2013,<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=12, page 12. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=12 Internet Archive]</ref> both restore “with Luke on owner’s Force Pile”.
